data.content_ref: inline:The target's rationale for sustaining §11.3 flags is self-undermining: it argues the two critics' failures are 'corroborative rather than independent,' but 'corroborative' mutual failure on a single shared artifact is the opposite of independent corroboration — it means the two data points are not independent evidence of a sustained flag, collapsing the very basis for adjudication. If both critics fail for the same reason against the same ground-truth, that is one failure observed twice, not a corroborated adjudication.
